|translation='''Title:''' Commander Vanden Willard.

'''Card text:'''
If deployed at a war room you control, each Rebel starship at that system card is power +1. May use 1 Force to cancel Astromech Shortage.

'''Lore:'''
One of the Rebel leaders on Yavin 4. Formerly attached to Suolriep sector HQ. For several years before the Senate's dissolution, he aided Princess Leia and Bail Organa as a Rebel spy.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese uses 操縦ドロイド不足 for Astromech Shortage.
